note: Everlasting Kings Park Festival runs 18 Sep - 4 Oct 2026 and had already begun when this was written, so the festival itself cannot be imported (the importer requires a future start). Moortabiny is its closing event and is still ahead, listed here a night at a time because each performance is its own sitting.

events.title: Moortabiny
events.description: The closing night of the Everlasting Kings Park Festival: a narrated drone show above the Western Australian Botanic Garden, written and voiced by Noongar author Kim Scott. Walk the gardens first, where sound stations play a score composed from Kings Park research data, then find a spot on the grass. Gates from 6.30pm; bring a picnic and something to sit on.
